verdict.rationale: Daily's recording docs mention individual media tracks stored in your own bucket, which gives some control over where recording data lives. Nothing in the evidence describes choosing a region or offering data-residency options. The EU-US Data Privacy Framework and global mesh network items cover compliance and routing, not storage location. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for call data, residency controls beyond recordings, explicit statement that bucket region determines storage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: individual media tracks stored in your own bucket
